subject: Milepost MAP: technical pairing & evaluation timing for BeaconAI
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@beaconai.com>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@beaconai.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Milepost MAP: technical pairing & evaluation timing for BeaconAI

Hi Lena / Marco —

Thanks again for the product demo last week. Per our conversation I wanted to put a short mutual action plan (MAP) on your radar and introduce the technical pairing team that will help run the evaluation. Goal is a 4–6 week scoped eval with clear success criteria so we can get you a firm TCO and recommended serving profile.

Proposed initial mileposts (high level):
- Week 0: Confirm success metrics, data flow, and staging access
- Week 1–2: Ingest sample dataset + run baseline latency/throughput tests
- Week 3: Quality checks and prompt-set validation
- Week 4: Cost/quantization experiments + go/no-go review

To support that we’ll pair you with: Dev Patel (Solutions Engineer) for infra/ingest and Vivek Kulkarni (ML Engineer) for model/latency tuning. I’ve attached a first-pass MAP (MAP-BeaconAI-v1.pdf) and a rough staging architecture (beacon-staging-arch.png).

Can you confirm: 1) the right technical lead for BeaconAI (I’ve used Lena, but correct me if wrong), 2) any non-negotiable compliance or data residency constraints, and 3) availability for an initial 30–45m technical kickoff this week?

If that all sounds OK I’ll schedule and include Dev + Vivek.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments:
- MAP-BeaconAI-v1.pdf (PDF, 18KB)
- beacon-staging-arch.png (PNG, 220KB)

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@beaconai.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 13:48:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Milepost MAP: technical pairing & evaluation timing for BeaconAI

Hi Soojin —

Thanks, this looks promising. I’m the engineering lead for integrations so I’ll be the primary technical contact. A few quick notes before we lock times:
- Data residency: production data must stay in our AWS account (us-east-1), for the eval we can supply a synthetic-but-realistic dataset but we’ll need the connector to point to a staging bucket in our account.
- Latency expectations: real-time inference targets are p95 < 120ms for single-turn responses; would like to understand how Redwood will measure p95 during the eval.
- Security: we’ll need an outline of the steps for key management and any shared secret handling.

I’m available for a kickoff Tue/Wed afternoon (EST) and can loop in Marco (infra). Go ahead and add Dev/Vivek.

—Lena
Lena Ortiz

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@beaconai.com>

Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Milepost MAP: technical pairing & evaluation timing for BeaconAI

Thanks for the intro — happy to run the infra/ingest work. Quick notes / asks ahead of kickoff:
- For staging we’ll need a short-lived IAM role with s3:GetObject/ListObject on the sample bucket (we won’t persist credentials). Can Lena confirm the ARN we should assume?
- If BeaconAI requires keys to remain in their KMS, we’ll integrate using customer-managed KMS; please send KMS key alias and a brief policy doc if that’s the route.
- I’ll bring a lightweight runbook to the kickoff that maps the MAP mileposts to concrete tasks (artifact names, test payloads, sample queries).

Vivek — from a model perspective, can you outline the baseline test matrix you want to run (sequence lengths, concurrency, latency measurement method)? I can pre-populate the staging cluster size so we have meaningful p95 numbers.

—Dev
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@beaconai.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:40:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Milepost MAP: technical pairing & evaluation timing for BeaconAI

Great — happy to own the model/latency work. Proposed baseline matrix (we can iterate):
- Prompts: 3 prompt-sets (short, medium, long) representative of BeaconAI’s production usage
- Sequence lengths: 64 / 256 / 1024 tokens
- Concurrency: single-user (1) and burst (10 concurrent)
- Metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, tail latency heatmap, and memory utilization

Measurement approach: use Redwood's built-in tracing + a custom client to replay recorded traffic. For p95 we’ll report end-to-end server-side p95 (model + network) and a client-side p95 so you can see differences. I’ll attach a short checklist and can run an initial lightweight sweep during the kickoff to validate signals.

Lena — for the IAM role and KMS info Dev requested, if you can share the staging bucket ARN and whether you prefer customer-managed KMS we’ll pre-configure the cluster. Also, which kickoff slot works for you?

—Vivek
ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
